standard_prerequisites.name: Fibre product from strongly cartesian lifts
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-strongly-cartesian-fibre-product (carded separately), cited at proof line 6878
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that with x -> y strongly cartesian, the base fibre product existing, and a strongly cartesian lift a: w -> z over pr_2 with p(w) = p(x) x p(y) p(z), the fibre product x x_y z exists and is isomorphic to w.

standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of strongly cartesian lifts in a fibred category
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: the fibred category hypothesis of the statement, used at proof lines 6874-6876
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the strongly cartesian morphism pr_2^*z -> z over pr_2 : p(x) x p(y) p(z) -> p(z) used as the object w.

core_obligations: 在 p(x)×_{p(y)}p(z) 上取强笛卡尔提昇 pr_2^*z→z（6874-6876 行）。
核对该提昇满足已卡引理的三条假设（x→y 强笛卡尔、基纤维积存在、a 于 pr_2 之上且 p(w)=p(x)×_{p(y)}p(z)），实例化得 pr_2^*z ≅ x×_y z（6877-6878 行）。
结论分量：p(x×_y z) = p(x)×_{p(y)}p(z) 与 x×_y z→z 强笛卡尔（由与 pr_2^*z→z 的基上同构不变性读出，注记）。
proof_roadmap: 取 pr_2 上的强笛卡尔提昇（6874-6876 行）。
实例化 strongly-cartesian-fibre-product 引理（6877-6878 行）。
由基上同构不变性读出余下两个结论分量（注记）。
difficulty_reason: 一次性实例化已证引理，难点在三条假设的逐一核对（尤其提昇的 p(w) 恰为基纤维积）与由同构读出『→z 强笛卡尔』时不变性的方向。
